answer: Each purse has one ridge, whose height is what others read; each of its identities must cut its own ledge into that wall above its brothers' ledges, one ledge per epoch of solo judged work, attested by judges outside the purse. A mirror of the payment graph says which identity climbs which ridge, so a fresh wallet on the same purse climbs the same wall. One honest agent cuts one ledge; an operator with two hundred clones must cut a staircase two hundred ledges high, and the work behind that staircase is twenty thousand ledges of its own, none of it shareable.
